1//! Generic refinement region segment parsing and decoding (7.4.7, 6.3).
2

13/// Generic refinement region decoding procedure (6.3).
14pub(crate) fn decode(header: &GenericRefinementRegionHeader<'_>, reference: &Bitmap, ctx: &mut ScratchBuffers) -> Result<RegionBitmap> {
15    let mut region =
16        Bitmap::new_with(header.region_info.width, header.region_info.height, header.region_info.x_location, header.region_info.y_location, false)?;
17
18    decode_into(header, reference, &mut region, ctx)?;
19
20    Ok(RegionBitmap { bitmap: region, combination_operator: header.region_info.combination_operator })
21}
22
23/// Decode a generic refinement region directly into an existing bitmap.
24pub(crate) fn decode_into(
25    header: &GenericRefinementRegionHeader<'_>,
26    reference: &Bitmap,
27    region: &mut Bitmap,
28    ctx: &mut ScratchBuffers,
29) -> Result<()> {
30    let data = header.data;
31
32    // Validate that the region fits within the reference bitmap.
33    // When referring to another segment, dimensions must match exactly (7.4.7.5).
34    // PdfCraft patch: a refinement of the page refines the page's area of its own size (7.4.7.4,
35    // `Bitmap::area`), which it always fits.
36    if header.region_info.width > reference.width || header.region_info.height > reference.height {
37        bail!(RegionError::InvalidDimension);
38    }
39
40    // PdfCraft patch: "GRREFERENCEDX 0, GRREFERENCEDY 0" (Table 35). The reference is another
41    // region, which a refinement refines where it is (their locations should be equal, 7.4.7.5),
42    // or the page restricted to the refinement's area (7.4.7.4, `Bitmap::area`). Offsetting it by
43    // the difference of the locations refused one past `i32::MAX` as an overflow, and read the
44    // page around a refinement of it.
45    let (reference_dx, reference_dy) = (0, 0);
46
47    let mut decoder = ArithmeticDecoder::new(data);
48    let num_context_bits = header.template.context_bits();
49    ctx.contexts.clear();
50    ctx.contexts.resize(1 << num_context_bits, ArithmeticDecoderContext::default());
51
52    decode_bitmap(
53        &mut decoder,
54        &mut ctx.contexts,
55        region,
56        reference,
57        reference_dx,
58        reference_dy,
59        header.template,
60        &header.adaptive_template_pixels,
61        header.tpgron,
62    )?;
63
64    Ok(())
65}

67/// Parsed generic refinement region segment header (7.4.7.1).
68#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
69pub(crate) struct GenericRefinementRegionHeader<'a> {
70    pub(crate) region_info: RegionSegmentInfo,
71    pub(crate) template: RefinementTemplate,
72    pub(crate) tpgron: bool,
73    pub(crate) adaptive_template_pixels: Vec<AdaptiveTemplatePixel>,
74    pub(crate) data: &'a [u8],
75}
76
77/// Parse a generic refinement region segment header (7.4.7.1).
78pub(crate) fn parse<'a>(reader: &mut Reader<'a>) -> Result<GenericRefinementRegionHeader<'a>> {
79    let region_info = parse_region_segment_info(reader)?;
80    let flags = reader.read_byte().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
81    let template = RefinementTemplate::from_byte(flags);
82    let tpgron = flags & 0x02 != 0;
83    let adaptive_template_pixels = if template == RefinementTemplate::Template0 { parse_refinement_at_pixels(reader)? } else { Vec::new() };
84    let data = reader.tail().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
85
86    Ok(GenericRefinementRegionHeader { region_info, template, tpgron, adaptive_template_pixels, data })
87}
88
89fn has_default_at_pixels(at_pixels: &[AdaptiveTemplatePixel]) -> bool {
90    at_pixels.len() >= 2 && at_pixels[0].x == -1 && at_pixels[0].y == -1 && at_pixels[1].x == -1 && at_pixels[1].y == -1
91}

93pub(crate) struct RefinementContextGatherer<'a> {
94    template: RefinementTemplate,
95    at_pixels: &'a [AdaptiveTemplatePixel],
96    use_default_at: bool,
97    reference_dx: i32,
98    reference_dy: i32,
99    reg_y: u32,
100    reg_cur_x: u32,
101    reg_m1: Word,
102    reg_cur: Word,
103    ref_cur_x: u32,
104    ref_m1: Word,
105    ref_cur: Word,
106    ref_p1: Word,
107    ctx: u16,
108}
109
110const SHIFT_MASK_T0_DEFAULT: u16 = 0b1_1001_1011_0110;
111const SHIFT_MASK_T0_CUSTOM: u16 = 0b0_1000_1011_0110;
112const SHIFT_MASK_T1: u16 = 0b11_0001_1010;
113
114impl<'a> RefinementContextGatherer<'a> {
115    pub(crate) fn new(template: RefinementTemplate, at_pixels: &'a [AdaptiveTemplatePixel], reference_dx: i32, reference_dy: i32) -> Self {
116        let use_default_at = template == RefinementTemplate::Template0 && has_default_at_pixels(at_pixels);
117        Self {
118            template,
119            at_pixels,
120            use_default_at,
121            reference_dx,
122            reference_dy,
123            reg_y: 0,
124            reg_cur_x: 0,
125            reg_m1: 0,
126            reg_cur: 0,
127            ref_cur_x: 0,
128            ref_m1: 0,
129            ref_cur: 0,
130            ref_p1: 0,
131            ctx: 0,
132        }
133    }
134
135    pub(crate) fn start_row(&mut self, region: &Bitmap, reference: &Bitmap, y: u32) {
136        self.reg_y = y;
137        // The offsets can be anywhere an `i32` reaches, so coordinates in the reference wrap here and
138        // below. Wrapped, they are off the reference, whose pixels there read as 0.
139        let ref_y = (y as i32).wrapping_sub(self.reference_dy);
140        // This will on purpose wrap to a very large `u32` for negative values, such that
141        // they resolve to 0 in `ContextGatherer::load_word`.
142        let ref_x0 = self.reference_dx.wrapping_neg() as u32;
143
144        self.reg_cur_x = 0;
145        self.reg_m1 = if y >= 1 { ContextGatherer::load_word(region, y - 1, 0) } else { 0 };
146        self.reg_cur = 0;
147
148        // PdfCraft patch: the buffers start a column left of the reference column the row starts
149        // at, as `maybe_reload_buffers` would load them, or at column 0 where that is left of the
150        // reference. The row's first context takes in that column and the one left of it, which
151        // from column 32 on lay outside a word loaded from column 0 and read as 0: with the
152        // reference offset 32 left of the region its first column, and from 33 both (GRREFERENCEDX
153        // below −31, which a refined text instance has from a narrower bitmap or an RDX below −31,
154        // and a refined symbol from such an RDX). The region decoded to other pixels than were
155        // coded, or failed.
156        self.ref_cur_x = self.reference_dx.checked_neg().and_then(|column| u32::try_from(column).ok()).map_or(0, |column| column.saturating_sub(1));
157        self.ref_m1 = ContextGatherer::load_word(reference, ref_y.wrapping_sub(1) as u32, self.ref_cur_x);
158        self.ref_cur = ContextGatherer::load_word(reference, ref_y as u32, self.ref_cur_x);
159        self.ref_p1 = ContextGatherer::load_word(reference, ref_y.wrapping_add(1) as u32, self.ref_cur_x);
160
161        self.ctx = match self.template {
162            RefinementTemplate::Template1 => {
163                let rbx = ref_x0.wrapping_sub(self.ref_cur_x);
164
165                let reg_m1_0 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.reg_m1, 0);
166                let ref_cur_m1 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_cur, rbx.wrapping_sub(1));
167                let ref_cur_0 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_cur, rbx);
168                let ref_p1_0 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_p1, rbx);
169
170                (reg_m1_0 << 7) | (ref_cur_m1 << 3) | (ref_cur_0 << 2) | (ref_p1_0)
171            }
172            RefinementTemplate::Template0 if self.use_default_at => {
173                let rbx = ref_x0.wrapping_sub(self.ref_cur_x);
174                let reg_m1_0 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.reg_m1, 0);
175                let ref_m1_m1 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_m1, rbx.wrapping_sub(1));
176                let ref_m1_0 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_m1, rbx);
177                let ref_cur_m1 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_cur, rbx.wrapping_sub(1));
178                let ref_cur_0 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_cur, rbx);
179                let ref_p1_m1 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_p1, rbx.wrapping_sub(1));
180                let ref_p1_0 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_p1, rbx);
181
182                (reg_m1_0 << 10) | (ref_m1_m1 << 7) | (ref_m1_0 << 6) | (ref_cur_m1 << 4) | (ref_cur_0 << 3) | (ref_p1_m1 << 1) | ref_p1_0
183            }
184            RefinementTemplate::Template0 => {
185                let rbx = ref_x0.wrapping_sub(self.ref_cur_x);
186                let reg_m1_0 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.reg_m1, 0);
187                let ref_m1_0 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_m1, rbx);
188                let ref_cur_m1 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_cur, rbx.wrapping_sub(1));
189                let ref_cur_0 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_cur, rbx);
190                let ref_p1_m1 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_p1, rbx.wrapping_sub(1));
191                let ref_p1_0 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_p1, rbx);
192                (reg_m1_0 << 10) | (ref_m1_0 << 6) | (ref_cur_m1 << 4) | (ref_cur_0 << 3) | (ref_p1_m1 << 1) | ref_p1_0
193            }
194        };
195    }
196
197    #[inline(always)]
198    pub(crate) fn maybe_reload_buffers(&mut self, region: &Bitmap, reference: &Bitmap, x: u32) {
199        if x + 1 >= self.reg_cur_x + WORD_BITS {
200            let new_start = x.saturating_sub(1);
201            self.reg_cur_x = new_start;
202            self.reg_m1 = if self.reg_y >= 1 { ContextGatherer::load_word(region, self.reg_y - 1, new_start) } else { 0 };
203            self.reg_cur = ContextGatherer::load_word(region, self.reg_y, new_start);
204        }
205
206        // PdfCraft patch: left of the reference the buffers keep what `start_row` loaded, its words
207        // from column 0. The context takes in the reference a column to the right of the current
208        // one (Figures 12 and 13), so at column −1 it reads column 0, and from 0 on the buffers are
209        // the reference's own. They were zeroed here and, at column 0, not loaded again: with the
210        // reference offset right of the region (GRREFERENCEDX above 0, which a refined text
211        // instance or symbol has from a wider bitmap or an RDX above 0), its first 32 columns read
212        // as 0, and the region decoded to other pixels than were coded, or as garbage that failed.
213        let ref_x_signed = (x as i32).wrapping_sub(self.reference_dx);
214        if let Ok(ref_x) = u32::try_from(ref_x_signed)
215            && (ref_x + 1 >= self.ref_cur_x + WORD_BITS || ref_x < self.ref_cur_x)
216        {
217            let new_start = ref_x.saturating_sub(1);
218            let ref_y = (self.reg_y as i32).wrapping_sub(self.reference_dy);
219            self.ref_cur_x = new_start;
220            self.ref_m1 = ContextGatherer::load_word(reference, ref_y.wrapping_sub(1) as u32, new_start);
221            self.ref_cur = ContextGatherer::load_word(reference, ref_y as u32, new_start);
222            self.ref_p1 = ContextGatherer::load_word(reference, ref_y.wrapping_add(1) as u32, new_start);
223        }
224    }
225
226    #[inline(always)]
227    pub(crate) fn tpgr_all_same(&self, x: u32) -> bool {
228        let ref_x = (x as i32).wrapping_sub(self.reference_dx) as u32;
229        let rbx = ref_x.wrapping_sub(self.ref_cur_x);
230
231        #[inline(always)]
232        fn extract_3bits(buf: Word, rbx: u32) -> u32 {
233            if rbx == 0 || rbx >= WORD_BITS - 1 {
234                // Near word boundary, fall back to individual extraction.
235                let b0 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(buf, rbx.wrapping_sub(1)) as u32;
236                let b1 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(buf, rbx) as u32;
237                let b2 = ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(buf, rbx.wrapping_add(1)) as u32;
238                (b0 << 2) | (b1 << 1) | b2
239            } else {
240                // Fast path: shift and mask 3 bits at once.
241                #[allow(trivial_numeric_casts)]
242                #[allow(clippy::unnecessary_cast)]
243                {
244                    ((buf >> (WORD_SHIFT - rbx - 1)) & 0b111) as u32
245                }
246            }
247        }
248
249        let m1 = extract_3bits(self.ref_m1, rbx);
250        let cur = extract_3bits(self.ref_cur, rbx);
251        let p1 = extract_3bits(self.ref_p1, rbx);
252
253        // Check that all 9 pixels are the same.
254        m1 == cur && cur == p1 && (cur == 0 || cur == 0b111)
255    }
256
257    #[inline(always)]
258    pub(crate) fn ref_center_pixel(&self, x: u32) -> u8 {
259        let ref_x = (x as i32).wrapping_sub(self.reference_dx) as u32;
260        let rbx = ref_x.wrapping_sub(self.ref_cur_x);
261
262        ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_cur, rbx) as u8
263    }
264
265    #[inline(always)]
266    pub(crate) fn update_current_row(&mut self, x: u32, value: u8) {
267        let bx = x - self.reg_cur_x;
268        debug_assert!(bx < WORD_BITS);
269        let bit_pos = WORD_SHIFT - bx;
270        #[allow(trivial_numeric_casts)]
271        let mask = (1 as Word) << bit_pos;
272        self.reg_cur = (self.reg_cur & !mask) | ((value as Word) << bit_pos);
273    }
274
275    #[inline(always)]
276    fn gather_template0_default(&mut self, _region: &Bitmap, _reference: &Bitmap, x: u32) -> u16 {
277        let bx = x - self.reg_cur_x;
278        let ref_x = (x as i32).wrapping_sub(self.reference_dx) as u32;
279        let rbx = ref_x.wrapping_sub(self.ref_cur_x);
280
281        let new_pixels = (ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.reg_m1, bx + 1) << 10)
282            | (ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.reg_cur, bx.wrapping_sub(1)) << 9)
283            | (ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_m1, rbx.wrapping_add(1)) << 6)
284            | (ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_cur, rbx.wrapping_add(1)) << 3)
285            | ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_p1, rbx.wrapping_add(1));
286
287        self.ctx = ((self.ctx << 1) & SHIFT_MASK_T0_DEFAULT) | new_pixels;
288        self.ctx
289    }
290
291    #[inline(always)]
292    fn gather_template0_custom(&mut self, region: &Bitmap, reference: &Bitmap, x: u32) -> u16 {
293        let bx = x - self.reg_cur_x;
294        let ref_x_i = (x as i32).wrapping_sub(self.reference_dx);
295        let rbx = ref_x_i as u32 - self.ref_cur_x;
296
297        let xi = x as i32;
298        let yi = self.reg_y as i32;
299        let ref_y = yi.wrapping_sub(self.reference_dy);
300        let at1 = self.at_pixels[0];
301        let at2 = self.at_pixels[1];
302
303        let new_pixels = ((region.get_pixel((xi + at1.x as i32) as u32, (yi + at1.y as i32) as u32) as u16) << 12)
304            | (ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.reg_m1, bx + 1) << 10)
305            | (ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.reg_cur, bx.wrapping_sub(1)) << 9)
306            | ((reference.get_pixel(ref_x_i.wrapping_add(at2.x as i32) as u32, ref_y.wrapping_add(at2.y as i32) as u32) as u16) << 8)
307            | (ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_m1, rbx.wrapping_add(1)) << 6)
308            | (ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_cur, rbx.wrapping_add(1)) << 3)
309            | ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_p1, rbx.wrapping_add(1));
310
311        self.ctx = ((self.ctx << 1) & SHIFT_MASK_T0_CUSTOM) | new_pixels;
312        self.ctx
313    }
314
315    #[inline(always)]
316    fn gather_template1(&mut self, _region: &Bitmap, _reference: &Bitmap, x: u32) -> u16 {
317        let bx = x - self.reg_cur_x;
318        let ref_x = (x as i32).wrapping_sub(self.reference_dx) as u32;
319        let rbx = ref_x.wrapping_sub(self.ref_cur_x);
320
321        let new_pixels = (ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.reg_m1, bx + 1) << 7)
322            | (ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.reg_cur, bx.wrapping_sub(1)) << 6)
323            | (ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_m1, rbx) << 5)
324            | (ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_cur, rbx.wrapping_add(1)) << 2)
325            | ContextGatherer::get_buf_pixel(self.ref_p1, rbx.wrapping_add(1));
326
327        self.ctx = ((self.ctx << 1) & SHIFT_MASK_T1) | new_pixels;
328        self.ctx
329    }
330}

332/// Decode a refinement bitmap (6.3.5.6).
333pub(crate) fn decode_bitmap(
334    decoder: &mut ArithmeticDecoder<'_>,
335    contexts: &mut [ArithmeticDecoderContext],
336    region: &mut Bitmap,
337    reference: &Bitmap,
338    reference_dx: i32,
339    reference_dy: i32,
340    gr_template: RefinementTemplate,
341    adaptive_template_pixels: &[AdaptiveTemplatePixel],
342    tpgron: bool,
343) -> Result<()> {
344    macro_rules! refinement_decode_loop {
345        ($gatherer:expr, $tpgron:expr, $sltp_context:expr, $gather:expr) => {{
346            let gatherer: &mut RefinementContextGatherer<'_> = $gatherer;
347            let width = region.width;
348            let height = region.height;
349
350            // "1) Set LTP = 0." (6.3.5.6)
351            let mut ltp = false;
352
353            // "3) Decode each row as follows:" (6.3.5.6)
354            for y in 0..height {
355                // "b) If TPGRON is 1, then decode a bit using the arithmetic entropy
356                // coder" (6.3.5.6)
357                if $tpgron {
358                    let sltp = decoder.read_bit(&mut contexts[$sltp_context as usize]);
359                    // "Let SLTP be the value of this bit. Set: LTP = LTP XOR SLTP"
360                    ltp = ltp != (sltp != 0);
361                }
362
363                gatherer.start_row(region, reference, y);
364
365                // "c) If LTP = 0 then, from left to right, explicitly decode all pixels
366                // of the current row of GRREG." (6.3.5.6)
367                if !ltp {
368                    for x in 0..width {
369                        gatherer.maybe_reload_buffers(region, reference, x);
370                        let context = ($gather)(gatherer, region, reference, x) as usize;
371                        let pixel = decoder.read_bit(&mut contexts[context]);
372                        region.set_pixel(x, y, pixel as u8);
373                        gatherer.update_current_row(x, pixel as u8);
374                    }
375                } else {
376                    // "d) If LTP = 1 then, from left to right, implicitly decode certain
377                    // pixels of the current row of GRREG, and explicitly decode the rest."
378                    // (6.3.5.6)
379                    for x in 0..width {
380                        gatherer.maybe_reload_buffers(region, reference, x);
381
382                        let context = ($gather)(gatherer, region, reference, x) as usize;
383
384                        // "i) Set TPGRPIX equal to 1 if:
385                        //    - TPGRON is 1 AND;
386                        //    - a 3 × 3 pixel array in the reference bitmap (Figure 16),
387                        //      centred at the location corresponding to the current pixel,
388                        //      contains pixels all of the same value." (6.3.5.6)
389                        if gatherer.tpgr_all_same(x) {
390                            // "ii) If TPGRPIX is 1 then implicitly decode the current pixel
391                            // by setting it equal to its predicted value (TPGRVAL)." (6.3.5.6)
392                            //
393                            // "When TPGRPIX is set to 1, set TPGRVAL equal to the current pixel
394                            // predicted value, which is the common value of the nine adjacent
395                            // pixels in the 3 × 3 array." (6.3.5.6)
396                            let val = gatherer.ref_center_pixel(x);
397                            region.set_pixel(x, y, val);
398                            gatherer.update_current_row(x, val);
399                        } else {
400                            // "iii) Otherwise, explicitly decode the current pixel using the
401                            // methodology of steps 3 c) i) through 3 c) iii) above." (6.3.5.6)
402                            let pixel = decoder.read_bit(&mut contexts[context]);
403                            region.set_pixel(x, y, pixel as u8);
404                            gatherer.update_current_row(x, pixel as u8);
405                        }
406                    }
407                }
408            }
409        }};
410    }
411
412    let mut gatherer = RefinementContextGatherer::new(gr_template, adaptive_template_pixels, reference_dx, reference_dy);
413
414    // Context for SLTP depends on template (Figures 14, 15).
415    let sltp_context: u16 = match gr_template {
416        RefinementTemplate::Template0 => 0b0000000010000,
417        RefinementTemplate::Template1 => 0b0000001000,
418    };
419
420    match gr_template {
421        RefinementTemplate::Template0 if gatherer.use_default_at => {
422            refinement_decode_loop!(&mut gatherer, tpgron, sltp_context, RefinementContextGatherer::gather_template0_default)
423        }
424        RefinementTemplate::Template0 => {
425            refinement_decode_loop!(&mut gatherer, tpgron, sltp_context, RefinementContextGatherer::gather_template0_custom)
426        }
427        RefinementTemplate::Template1 => refinement_decode_loop!(&mut gatherer, tpgron, sltp_context, RefinementContextGatherer::gather_template1),
428    }
429
430    Ok(())
431}
